verdict.rationale: Folk's documented REST API supports creating a person and requesting enrichment of up to 500 people, with a webhook firing when enrichment finishes. An official MCP server is documented for importing contacts and updating records, so an agent can create and enrich a lead. Nothing shows owner assignment or company-level data filling through the API or MCP. missing for 10: documented owner/assignee field or endpoint, explicit company-data enrichment via API/MCP, an end-to-end agent walkthrough, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Create a person: Create a new person in the workspace.

subscribe a webhook to the `person_enrichment.finished` event
